description: Make a video file of the film, one scene or one shot, the same way Export does, and follow or stop it. action start (default): starts the render and returns at once; it gives no file yet. action status (read-only): stage, progress (0 to 1), frames and seconds so far; when done, the file path; or the error. Call it every 10 to 30 seconds while running. action cancel: stops the running render (no file is made; safe when nothing runs). Only one render runs at a time, and look_at_shot doesn't work while it runs. quality draft is 540p and quick (for checking timing); final is full size and much slower. make wav or mp3 exports only the sound. Without save_to it goes to Dinoctor's renders folder.

action.description: start (default) a render, status of the render, or cancel it.

blur.description: Motion blur for final (about 4 times slower). Default on where possible.

id.description: start: a scene id (what: scene) or shot id (what: shot).

replace.description: Write over save_to if it's already there.

save_to.description: Full path of the file to make, ending in .mp4 (or .wav/.mp3). Ask the person where if they care.

scene.description: start: scene index from 0 (what: scene or shot).

shot.description: start: shot index from 0 in that scene (what: shot).

shot_id.description: start: a shot id to render that shot.

what.description: start: what to render. Default film (shot when shot_id is given).

name: render
